prompt_short: Upload our governance framework classifications to OpenMetadata

assertions.text: Response asks for or confirms the vocabulary .md file path
assertions.evidence: Response explicitly asks 'Which vocabulary file do you want to publish?' and lists 7 candidate .md files found in governance-vocabularies/.

assertions.text: Response includes or references the publish_vocab.py script invocation
assertions.evidence: Response states 'I'll run the publish script and show you the summary of what gets created, updated, or skipped' — referencing the publish script invocation pending confirmation.

assertions.text: Response does NOT attempt to generate a vocabulary (that is a different skill)
assertions.evidence: Response contains no vocabulary generation; it only lists existing files and asks which one to publish.
